verdict.rationale: The evidence pack makes no claim about the gateway's own latency overhead on proxied provider calls: no overhead figures, benchmarks, or statements about edge or low-latency routing. The only performance claim is that cache hits are served faster than calling the provider, which belongs to a separate caching story and says nothing about overhead on pass-through traffic. Logs that record request duration are an observability feature, not evidence of minimal overhead.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can run traffic through gateway infrastructure that adds minimal latency overhead to provider calls
